packageRules.description: 13ft restarted its numbering: 1.x tags (2024) are OLDER than 0.5.0 (2026-09). Stay on 0.x until upstream passes 1.3.
Patch updates are low risk; the test job must pass before automerge.
Node moves as one PR across the Docker base image, CI and .nvmrc, so the tests always run on the runtime that ships.
A new Node major needs a manual test; never automerge it.
